test_title: PYST 51: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

CREATION : ETGCVKQP :: UNIVERSE : WPKXGTUG :: PLANET :?
solution:
The position and positional values of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is: **All the letters of a word are increased by 2.**

For, CREATION : ETGCVKQP 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5ed97e27bb197c966d64c294faa84e30ad740889d27720fb68e68f9ba1e64cd.png] 

For, UNIVERSE : WPKXGTUG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2b46ae87cd2411e0138a8884e955c69f85c50cee01e4a9c4eb34d8378ba518b.png] 

Similarly, **PLANET :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2e908bf392826ceff283a165fe5e9cd7c7281b552d7db4595341c7a3562ee6b.png] 

So, **PLANET** will be **RNCPGV.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 1'.***
